summary: The robot freezes and crashes because pulseIn() has no timeout when the ultrasonic sensor fails to receive an echo in a long corridor, blocking the loop for a full second per reading.

causes.title: pulseIn() lacks a timeout, causing 1-second freezes
causes.why: Trace: pulseIn(18)=0 took 1000018 us (15 slow call(s) logged).
causes.check: Verify that when the sonar points down a long corridor (no echo), the Serial log pauses for exactly one second.
causes.fix: Pass a timeout argument to pulseIn, e.g., pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH, 30000).

rule_findings.title: pulseIn() has no timeout and can freeze loop() for 1 second
rule_findings.evidence: pulseIn(pin, level) waits up to 1,000,000 us when no echo returns (object out of range).
rule_findings.fix: Pass a timeout: pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH, 30000) caps the wait near 30 ms (about 5 m).

rule_findings.title: pulseIn() on line 17 blocked for 1.00 s
rule_findings.evidence: Trace: pulseIn(18)=0 took 1000022 us (15 slow call(s) logged).
rule_findings.fix: Pass a timeout as the third argument, e.g. pulseIn(ECHO, HIGH, 30000).
